title: Acantha
summary: ACANTH'A, noun [Gr. a spine or thorn.] In botany, a prickle; in zoology, a spine or prickly fin; an acute process of the vertebers.

inlines.v: ACANTH'A, noun [Gr. a spine or thorn.] In botany, a prickle; in zoology, a spine or prickly fin; an acute process of the vertebers.
